checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'warehouse-query' and the description includes trigger phrases.

checks.description: The query is anchored to the strategy-artifact success_metric and never an invented metric.
checks.rule: Body maps the monitoring question to the success_metric set in the strategy-artifact, stops-and-asks if it is absent, and never invents a metric or substitutes a vanity metric.

checks.description: The query is specified in natural language and SQL or the MCP call, with named tables and fields.
checks.rule: Body and template define a query_intent in natural language and a query as SQL or the BigQuery MCP call, naming source tables, fields, and the time window.

checks.description: The BigQuery MCP is not yet approved; the query is gated and added on approval, not assumed live.
checks.rule: Body states the BigQuery MCP is not yet approved, the query is gated and added on approval, and the skill does not run against the warehouse before approval.

checks.description: Data-access open items are surfaced rather than filled by assumption.
checks.rule: Body surfaces data-access open items (MCP approval, missing table, unconfirmed field, instrumentation gap) instead of assuming a table or field.

checks.description: No personal or sensitive data is exposed in query outputs.
checks.rule: Body states no personal or sensitive data appears in a query output, only the fields the metric needs are selected, and no personal data goes in a tracking parameter.

checks.description: A usable warehouse query spec template exists.
checks.rule: templates/warehouse-query-spec.md exists and contains question, success_metric, query_intent, query, data_access_open_items, and privacy_note sections.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the skill files.
checks.rule: No file in this skill contains the U+2014 em dash, the U+0640 tatweel, or Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669).
